description: Defines a custom Flutter widget named CheckMark, which displays a circular avatar with an SVG checkmark icon inside. It is used for UI indication, such as marking items as checked.

classes.name: CheckMark
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a circular check mark with customizable colors, padding, and size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CheckMark widget, returning a CircleAvatar containing an SVG image.
